technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish but short-term momentum weak; price below key moving averages with negative volume/CMF signals suggest waiting for confirmation before entry.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (232.6) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 51 days add event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, Ichimoku above cloud, Supertrend bullish) with price near support (226.70) in fear-driven market presents contrarian opportunity for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 232.6), weak short-term momentum (RSI 33-34, price below EMA 9/21), negative volume/CMF, high earnings risk in 51 days, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction make entry premature and high-risk.
